spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

## ¶1

[GAP-1] upon [GAP-2] from [GAP-3] thus [GAP-4]

*This paragraph is almost entirely lacuna. The surviving connective words ("upon," "from," "thus") suggest a causal sequence — an influx descending from a higher spiritual origin into a consequent state — but the substance is lost. No confident spiritual reading can be given beyond that skeletal movement of influx.*

---

## ¶2

[GAP-5] the totality of these states [GAP-6] that they shall [GAP-7] seven complete degrees of the regenerating mind [GAP-8]. Again, he too, this very [GAP-9: individual spiritual intelligence] — in the season when [GAP-10] of divine wisdom [GAP-11] the whole of the spiritual world [GAP-12] is opened to interior perception [GAP-13] — receives into divine wisdom [GAP-14] entirely, according to the mode in which his spiritual life subsists [GAP-15] from [GAP-16] these remaining three degrees of interior order [GAP-17].

### Notes on the reading:

- **"all of them"** → the totality of spiritual states under discussion.
- **"seven people"** → seven signifies what is full and complete; "people" corresponds to discrete states or degrees of the mind undergoing regeneration — the complete series of spiritual development.
- **"this person"** → a particular spiritual intelligence or angelic form progressing through these states.
- **"of the light"** → of divine wisdom (light = truth proceeding from the Divine).
- **"the universe"** → the whole spiritual world, or the Grand Human in its fullness.
- **"is revealed"** → interior perception is opened; what was hidden in correspondence becomes manifest.
- **"take to the light"** → to receive into, or be conjoined with, divine wisdom.
- **"the way that he exists"** → the specific mode or quality of that intelligence's spiritual life — his ruling love and its form.
- **"these other three"** → three remaining discrete degrees (likely celestial, spiritual, and natural — the tripartite order of influx), distinguished from the sevenfold completeness of regeneration mentioned above. The "three" points to the essential structural degrees through which the Divine flows into created minds.

*The passage, despite its fragmentary state, appears to describe how a spiritual intelligence, at the appointed state of readiness, receives divine wisdom fully — and how that reception accords with three interior discrete degrees that constitute the architecture of the regenerating mind within the complete (sevenfold) process.*

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [The mind of the light came down] upon [the earth] from [the height] thus [it is]

[Once more he says concerning a]ll of them [are established by the light, so] that they shall [be purified and attain to the rank of] seven people [who shall be perfected in the light] Again, he too, this per[son, in] the time when [the mind] of the light [shall be made manifest and shall fill all of] the universe [and all the mystery that is within it] is revealed [to him, and he shall] take to the light [completely and utt]erly, the way that he exists [and receives his life and his portion] from [among] these other three [aeons]

fills.fill: The mind of the light came down
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading identifies a descending influx from a higher spiritual origin; in Manichaean Kephalaia register, the Nous (Mind) of Light descending is the primary vehicle of divine influx upon the earth.
The target of descending influx ("upon X") is the natural plane — "the earth" in Kephalaia cosmological vocabulary, corresponding to the consequent lower state receiving influx from above.
The source of influx ("from X") is the higher spiritual origin; "the height" (Coptic pjise) is the standard Kephalaia term for the transcendent realm from which divine power descends.
Following "thus," a categorical affirmation closes the statement of influx — "thus it is" is a standard Kephalaia concluding formula affirming the established cosmic order.

fills.fill: Once more he says concerning a
fills.explanation: The opening of ¶2 requires a standard Kephalaia discourse formula before "all of them"; "Once more he says concerning" is the conventional teaching introduction, with "a" joining "ll" to form "all."

fills.fill: are established by the light, so
fills.explanation: Between "all of them" and the purpose clause "that they shall," a main predicate is needed; "are established by the light" describes the divine ordering of these states into the complete regenerative series.

fills.fill: be purified and attain to the rank of
fills.explanation: The verb phrase connecting "they shall" to "seven people" must express completion through regeneration; "be purified and attain to the rank of" captures both the purification process and the attainment of the seven complete degrees.

fills.fill: who shall be perfected in the light
fills.explanation: Following "seven people," a qualifying clause closes the first section; "perfected in the light" describes the completed state of the seven regenerative degrees before transitioning to the specific individual case.
Completes "person" from "per-" and provides the preposition "in" connecting to "the time when," matching the spiritual reading's "in the season when" — the appointed state of readiness.
The subject preceding "of the light" is the Nous — "the mind of the light" is the central Manichaean divine intelligence corresponding to divine wisdom proceeding from the Divine in Swedenborg.

fills.fill: shall be made manifest and shall fill all of
fills.explanation: The verb phrase describing what the mind of the light does to the universe — it is made manifest (corresponding to interior perception opening) and fills the whole spiritual world with divine wisdom.

fills.fill: and all the mystery that is within it
fills.explanation: Between "the universe" and "is revealed," the text specifies what is revealed — the hidden mysteries within the spiritual world, corresponding to what is opened to interior perception.

Connects "is revealed" to "take to the light" — the mystery is revealed to the person, and he shall then receive into divine wisdom, matching the spiritual reading's sequence of perception opening followed by reception.
The fill provides emphatic hendiadys before "utterly" — "completely and utterly" corresponds to "entirely" in the spiritual reading, expressing the totality of reception into divine wisdom.

fills.fill: and receives his life and his portion
fills.explanation: Connects "the way that he exists" to "from these other three aeons" — the person's spiritual life subsists by receiving his portion from the three discrete degrees, matching Swedenborg's doctrine that life flows in through the three degrees of interior order.
"From among" is a standard Kephalaia construction indicating the source or context from which something is derived — here the three discrete degrees from which the person's spiritual life proceeds.

The three structural degrees of interior order (celestial, spiritual, natural) correspond in Manichaean Kephalaia vocabulary to "aeons" — the fundamental cosmological realms through which divine influx flows into created minds.
